tools.name: business_set
tools.description: Store the sender details printed on every proposal, contract and letter, plus the currency, VAT, terms and prefix defaults. It writes the SAME shared profile as the invoice server's business_set.

tools.name: doc_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a real .docx file from structured sections. Returns the file path, the number of blocks written and the layout used. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_from_markdown
tools.description: Call this tool to turn markdown into a .docx and return the path with a count of blocks by type. Headings, lists, GFM tables and code fences are honoured. An existing file is kept unless overwrite.

tools.name: doc_read
tools.description: Call this tool to extract the text of an existing .docx. Returns an outline of the headings and the full text in document order, or the block structure. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_to_html
tools.description: Call this tool to convert a .docx to semantic HTML you can open in a browser and print to PDF. Returns the path of the .html file. This is the supported PDF route; no PDF is rendered here. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_fill_template
tools.description: Call this tool to replace {{placeholders}} in a .docx and write a new file, reporting what was filled, unfilled or ignored. Call it with no values to list them. Free: templates up to 10 placeholders.

tools.name: proposal_create
tools.description: Call this tool to produce a client-ready .docx proposal from summary, scope, deliverables, timeline, price and terms. Returns the reference, the total and the file path. Free tier: 3 proposals or contracts per month.

tools.name: proposal_update
tools.description: Rewrite an existing proposal in place from its reference. Only the fields you pass change; the rest comes from the data stored at creation. Returns the fields that changed and the file path.

tools.name: contract_create
tools.description: Call this tool to produce a freelance service agreement .docx. Returns the reference, the fee and the file path. It is a template skeleton for a lawyer to review, not legal advice. Free tier: 3 agreements per month.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this endpoint's licence state for your token as JSON: the product, the tier free or pro, why it is not Pro, and the checkout URL. Call it to explain a free-tier refusal. No arguments, nothing changes.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.

tools.name: doc_upload
tools.description: Send an existing Word document to this hosted endpoint. There is no filesystem here, so instead of a path you upload the file once with doc_upload and then pass its name as `path` to doc_read, doc_to_html and doc_fill_template. Give exactly one of docx_base64 or url. url: fetch a public file instead

tools.name: doc_files
tools.description: List the documents uploaded for your token, with their sizes.

tools.name: doc_delete_upload
tools.description: Delete one document uploaded for your token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "docx" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: doc_to_html, doc_upload · Private data: doc_create, doc_from_markdown, doc_read, doc_to_html, doc_fill_template, proposal_create, proposal_update, contract_create, license_status, license_activate, doc_upload, doc_files, doc_delete_upload · Public sink: doc_upload, doc_delete_upload · Destructive: doc_from_markdown, doc_delete_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: doc_to_html, doc_upload · Private data: doc_create, doc_from_markdown, doc_read, doc_to_html, doc_fill_template, proposal_create, proposal_update, contract_create, license_status, license_activate, doc_upload, doc_files, doc_delete_upload · Public sink: doc_upload, doc_delete_upload · Destructive: doc_from_markdown, doc_delete_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
